description.value: Spoke N' Motion is a full-service bike and ski shop that has been a Kamloops institution since 1987, billing itself as the store 'Known by riders, Owned by riders.' Certified mechanics handle everything from minor adjustments to complete suspension rebuilds, and the shop carries a broad range of mountain, road, gravel, fat, and electric bikes. For cyclists passing through the Thompson Valley, it offers a knowledgeable, rider-run resource backed by over three decades of local experience.
